text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a Member of the Children of the Cathedral.
source_text: You see a Member of the Children of the Cathedral.

text: 你看见一个大教堂的教徒。
source_text: 你看见一个大教堂的教徒。

text: I do not speak with heathen souls such as yourself.
source_text: I do not speak with heathen souls such as yourself.

text: 我不和异教的人说话，比如说你。
source_text: 我不和异教的人说话，比如说你。

text: Your report, VanHagan.
source_text: Your report, VanHagan.

text: 你的报告，范·海根。
source_text: 你的报告，范·海根。

text: The Master is pleased with your progress, but his need is great and time is limited.
source_text: The Master is pleased with your progress, but his need is great and time is limited.

text: 主教对于你的进展很满意，但他的需求很大，给你的时间也很有限。
source_text: 主教对于你的进展很满意，但他的需求很大，给你的时间也很有限。

text: The Master should know that raw material is limited. We cannot create our soldiers without more stock.
source_text: The Master should know that raw material is limited. We cannot create our soldiers without more stock.

text: 主教应该知道原料已经不多了，如果没有原料我们就不能制造我们的战士。
source_text: 主教应该知道原料已经不多了，如果没有原料我们就不能制造我们的战士。

text: He is aware of your problems. He is working on it, as we speak.
source_text: He is aware of your problems. He is working on it, as we speak.

text: 他意识到了你说的问题。他正在做这个，正像我们说的。
source_text: 他意识到了你说的问题。他正在做这个，正像我们说的。

text: Tell me of his plans. We will need to coordinate activities, if the Unity is to succeed.
source_text: Tell me of his plans. We will need to coordinate activities, if the Unity is to succeed.

text: 告诉我他的计划，我们必须配合行动，“同一”事业才能取得成功。
source_text: 告诉我他的计划，我们必须配合行动，“同一”事业才能取得成功。

text: The Master has become aware of an undiscovered, and living, Vault. With that much raw material, we can create a great force. According to the prediction software, it will be the numbers we need to succeed.
source_text: The Master has become aware of an undiscovered, and living, Vault. With that much raw material, we can create a great force. According to the prediction software, it will be the numbers we need to succeed.

text: 主教觉察到一个运转良好并且不为人知的避难所。那里有很多的原料，我们可以建立一支庞大的军队。按照软件预测，那里的原料数量足够我们取得胜利。
source_text: 主教觉察到一个运转良好并且不为人知的避难所。那里有很多的原料，我们可以建立一支庞大的军队。按照软件预测，那里的原料数量足够我们取得胜利。

text: Excellent. This is most fortuitous. Are the inhabitants contaminated?
source_text: Excellent. This is most fortuitous. Are the inhabitants contaminated?

text: 太棒了。真是幸运。居民们都被污染了吗？
source_text: 太棒了。真是幸运。居民们都被污染了吗？

text: Oh, this is the best part. If their representative is any example, they are clean. Pure-strain.
source_text: Oh, this is the best part. If their representative is any example, they are clean. Pure-strain.

text: 哦，这才是最令人高兴的地方。如果那里居民中的样品是典型的，那他们真的是干净的，纯种的。
source_text: 哦，这才是最令人高兴的地方。如果那里居民中的样品是典型的，那他们真的是干净的，纯种的。

text: Oh, this is most exciting. What Vault is it that we plunder?
source_text: Oh, this is most exciting. What Vault is it that we plunder?

text: 哦，这真令人兴奋，我们要洗劫哪个避难所？
source_text: 哦，这真令人兴奋，我们要洗劫哪个避难所？

text: Vault-13. And we shall have them soon. Very soon.
source_text: Vault-13. And we shall have them soon. Very soon.

text: 13号避难所。我们马上就要占领它了，马上。
source_text: 13号避难所。我们马上就要占领它了，马上。

text: You gain 1000 experience points for overhearing the whole conversation about your Vault.
source_text: You gain 1000 experience points for overhearing the whole conversation about your Vault.

text: 你偷听到关于你避难所的完整谈话，得到了1000点经验值。
source_text: 你偷听到关于你避难所的完整谈话，得到了1000点经验值。
